Three systems doing the quiet work underneath.

J

Jarvis, adaptive AI

Watches how a student actually studies — what they finish, what they skip, what time of day they focus — and reshapes quests and recommendations around it, continuously.

Q

Gamified quests

Daily platform tasks and teacher-assigned homework both feed the same quest engine. Complete one, get paid — small amounts, but immediate and real.

₹

Fintech engine

One wallet clears everything: $5 subscriptions, teacher trial payouts, quest earnings, and B2B project payments — reconciled in a single ledger per user.
